title: support undo discoverable
rule: Support Undo that stays discoverable — visible control; snackbar-only undo that vanishes in seconds is a miss. Always allow Back; cancel in-progress. (Heuristic #3 not filed as a catalog row.)
pass_when: Undo is a discoverable visible control (not only a vanishing snackbar); Back is available; in-progress work can be cancelled.
fail_when: Undo only as a seconds-long snackbar; no Back; no cancel in-progress.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: Heuristic #3 as a row; `actions.multilevel_undo` / `actions.cancelability` as merges. Overlap with Actions 40: `multilevel_undo` / `cancelability`.
